githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 4 adds a reaction details browser, an optional Read All button, Hide Muted Channels, and live server timeout handling. It also improves media playback, message bubbles, and server navigation.

## Reactions

- Added View Reactions to browse participants by emoji, including people who used Super Reactions.
- Improved reaction feedback, participant previews, and recovery from temporary rate limits.
- Fixed reaction picker and details popovers losing their attachment while scrolling.

## Servers and unread tracking

- Added an optional Read All button in Features settings to mark unread server channels and active joined threads as read after confirmation, including muted conversations.
- Added Hide Muted Channels to server menus, synchronized with Discord, and channel context menus in Browse Channels to unmute hidden channels.
- Improved server and folder animations, drag feedback, unread indicators, and click targets.
- Fixed conversations remaining unread when Discord supplied no usable read boundary, and prevented local message placeholders from disrupting read tracking.

## Server timeouts

- Added a timeout notice and countdown in server and thread composers.
- Updated communication actions when a timeout starts, changes, ends, or expires, while preserving message drafts.

## Media playback and previews

- Added YouTube playback in the media viewer, with playback position remembered during the current app session.
- Fixed article previews displaying their main image as a small thumbnail and improved video poster handling.

## Message appearance

- Improved how polls, server invites, thread previews, and SakuraCord link cards fit into message bubbles.
- Replaced the large message-style preview with compact selectable cards and refined message typography and server tags.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-3...v0.1.7-Beta-4](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-3...v0.1.7-Beta-4)
discordAnnouncement:
**Reaction details, Read All, and timeout countdowns 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Browse participants by emoji with View Reactions, including people who used Super Reactions.
- Enable Read All in Features to mark unread server conversations as read after confirmation.
- Hide muted channels through the server menu, synchronized with Discord.
- See a countdown while timed out, keep your drafts, and regain available actions when the timeout ends.
- Play YouTube videos in the media viewer and resume within the current app session, with improved article and video previews.
- Refined server and folder animations, larger click targets, compact message-style cards, and better rich content in bubbles.
